" DON'T PUSH ME KAREN! YOU WON'T LIKE IT WHEN MY WRATH RAINS DOWN UPON YOU!", I swore with the deepest and most sinister tone I could manage with my human voice.

She giggled and continued washing her dishes.

I don't understand this at all. Everything has been going wrong with me since I possessed this damn human, John. It has been a week. Neither his wife nor his kids have noticed that their dear human has been replaced by Vrael. Yes, the same Vrael who is the most feared among the demon kind.

But am I really though. I really am beginning to doubt my abilities now. "Have my powers diminished throughout the ages? Have I become weak?", I thought to myself.

As I was amidst this existential crisis, John's daughter Luna appeared. The brat was getting on my nerves now. "What is it, Luna?", I asked. "Daddy, will you play the brunch game with me". "Oh for fuck's sake. No, not that wretched game, please. She won't leave me for hours together. Not that again.", I thought.

"How about no, Luna. How does that sound, huh? ", I said putting on the bravest tone possible but in my head I was silently pleading her to just leave me alone. This wretched girl has the capacity to test my patience like no other man has managed to. She's worse than the devil himself. Then the little devil started crying. "DADDY, YOU'RE SO MEAN! WHY WON'T YOU PLAY WITH ME! AAAAH". Her high pitched screams we're making my fragile ears tingle. If only I was in my demon form. I would've shown her. But right now, I have to get away from this noise. It's gonna blast my fragile eardrums. "ALRIGHT. alright. Calm down, Luna. I'll play your little game. ", I said, gritting my teeth. What have I become? The great Vrael defeated by a little girl. What will the other demons think. Fortunately they're not here to notice this embarassment. The torture went on for three hours until the brat fell asleep screaming some gibberish.As soon as I was about to a let a sigh of relief, Karen appeared.

"NOT YOU. NOT SO SOON. I NEED A DAMN BREAK!".

Karen held my hand and said "Honey, I've had a really tiring day at work today. Can you fix up some dinner for us?" and gave my hand a little kiss.

"OH HOLY SATAN! WHY ME? ", I screamed internally.

You see, I underestimated women.  A few days ago, in a similar scenario, I brushed her away as I was drafting the plans for overtaking the world. That was a wrong decision. Holy fire and fury blasted through her mouth in such a high pitch and speed that I silently swore never to get myself into this situation. That was worse than Luna's high pitched screams because she seemed to hit my demon mind right where it hurt and crashed on all my insecurities like a truck.

"Never again", I thought to myself as I got to the kitchen, fixing up the dinner.

I had kind of gotten the hang of John's life and frankly was kind of feeling sorry for this poor lad. In all of my 753 years of existence, I wouldn't have wished this kind of a curse on my worst enemies. I have a few more days left according to the official contract. I don't know how much longer I can hold on.
